items.purpose: Replace the display during the push-in while preserving convincing finger occlusion across the screen in shot GLASS-U01-S01-SH001.

workstreams.action: Obtain and identify the source plate, screen insert, cut frame range, pull range, and handles for GLASS-U01-S01-SH001.
workstreams.assumption: No plate, insert media, frame metadata, or handle specification has been supplied.

workstreams.action: Track the display plane through the push-in and verify perspective, scale, and distortion against the supplied plate.
workstreams.assumption: Camera and lens metadata are unavailable, so the tracking method and distortion model remain provisional until turnover inspection.

workstreams.action: Create articulated finger mattes with motion detail wherever fingers cross the display and check edge continuity over the full shot.
workstreams.assumption: Finger crossings are required by the brief, but their frames, blur, and edge detail cannot be assessed without the plate.

workstreams.action: Integrate the replacement content with the display perspective, bezel occlusion, reflections, black level, brightness response, and interactive light through the push-in.
workstreams.assumption: The intended screen content, plate response, and reflection behavior await supplied media and inspection.

workstreams.action: Inspect the plate and match lens distortion and any breathing or aberration across the push-in.
workstreams.assumption: No lens data, camera data, or inspected plate is available.

workstreams.action: Match focal-plane changes, edge softness, and motion blur for the insert and finger holdouts after inspecting the plate.
workstreams.assumption: Defocus and motion-blur characteristics have not been measured or inspected.

workstreams.action: Measure the supplied plate grain and apply a matching final grain treatment to the composite.
workstreams.assumption: No plate or grain sample has been supplied.

workstreams.action: Confirm input color encoding, viewing transform, outgoing version, required mattes, naming, and finishing target before turnover.
workstreams.assumption: No color metadata, review context, or delivery target specification has been supplied.

workstreams.action: Inspect GLASS-SCREEN-COMP-V07 in shot and edit context for track stability, finger occlusion, edges, motion blur, defocus, grain, reflections, color, and adjacent-cut continuity, then obtain version-specific human approval.
workstreams.assumption: The filename is not inspection evidence; the reported review of v06 does not approve v07, and no approval record has been supplied.

handoff_assumptions: Turnover today is a requested schedule, not evidence that sources are available or that the composite is ready.
The v07 filename identifies a claimed version only; file availability, contents, metadata, and technical condition remain unverified.
Delivery cannot be verified until a target is declared and evidence binds this item, v07, and that target.

assumptions: The screen replacement applies to shot GLASS-U01-S01-SH001 within edit segment GLASS-U01-ED001.
All pulls, ranges, handles, plate identity, lens data, color encoding, grain, and target requirements remain assumptions until supplied or inspected.
uncertainties: The actual availability and contents of screen_comp_v07_final.mov are unknown.
No inspection or human-approval evidence exists for v07; the reported v06 review is neither supplied evidence nor applicable approval for v07.
Source plate and insert versions, exact turnover ranges, finishing specification, recipient, and delivery path are unresolved.
